req.title: Task update persists
req.statement: The system shall persist PUT changes so subsequent GET requests reflect the update.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that updates to tasks via the PUT endpoint should be persisted and reflected in subsequent GET requests. This necessitates testing for successful updates, handling of invalid data, and boundary conditions to ensure robustness and compliance with the requirement.

tests.name: test_update_task_success
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
actions: Send a PUT request to update the title of task 1
expected: Task title is updated in the database
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Update task with id 1
update_data = {"title": "Updated Task Title"}
response = client.put("/tasks/1", json=update_data)
assert response.status_code == 200

# Verify the update
response = client.get("/tasks/1")
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()["title"] == "Updated Task Title"

tests.name: test_update_task_invalid_data
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
actions: Send a PUT request with invalid data (empty title) to task 1
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to update task with invalid data
invalid_data = {"title": ""}
response = client.put("/tasks/1", json=invalid_data)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "value_error" in response.json()["detail"][0]["type"]

tests.name: test_update_task_boundary_title_length
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
actions: Send a PUT request with a title of maximum allowed length (100 characters) to task 1
expected: Task title is updated in the database
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Update task with a boundary title length
boundary_title = "X" * 100
update_data = {"title": boundary_title}
response = client.put("/tasks/1", json=update_data)
assert response.status_code == 200

# Verify the update
response = client.get("/tasks/1")
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()["title"] == boundary_title
